name: What types of sliding glass doors are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of sliding glass doors are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's a wide variety of sliding glass door types to suit different needs and styles. Common options include standard two-panel sliders, multi-panel doors that open wider, and pocket doors that disappear into the wall for a completely unobstructed opening. Materials range from durable vinyl, which is low-maintenance and energy-efficient, to robust aluminum for a sleek modern look, and fiberglass, known for its strength and ability to mimic wood. Glass options include double-pane, low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings for energy savings, and tempered glass for safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available types include two-panel, multi-panel, and pocket doors, made from materials like vinyl, aluminum, or fiberglass, with various glass options.
